body:
## Summary

Refs #33 (FA-032). Closure is a separate step; the GitHub issue stays OPEN.

The upstream profile feature promised automatic exclusion and no external transfer without code that enforced either, wrote sampled content and project paths into the model-input file before any redaction, redacted only `evidence` while rendering `evidence_quotes`, summaries, instructions and project labels outside that pass, and printed "None detected" whenever the counter was zero. Zeus has no profile feature; this PR adds the boundary contract and its enforcing code without collecting any conversation or calling any model. Every test input is a synthetic sentinel.

- `domain/profile_privacy.py` (stdlib only): `parse_policy` (versioned: fields + purpose, read scope with caps, model name/transport, temporary/permanent retention, notice with a closed claim list; **the notice may only claim what the policy enforces**: `no_external_transfer` needs a local transport, `raw_not_retained` needs profile-only retention; a wider notice refuses the policy); `parse_consent` (bound to the policy hash and to in-scope projects; cancel, questionnaire and a grant without projects collect nothing); `scan`/`redact` (private key, credential incl. Korean labels, token, email, Windows/Linux/WSL user paths, Luhn-checked card numbers; kinds and spans only, never values); `minimize` (policy fields only, cap, scan, redact, non-reversible `project_ref`; a private key / credential / token **blocks** the record instead of masking it; read/parse/out-of-scope/not-consented failures name the fields they could not check); `normalize_evidence` (`evidence` and `evidence_quotes` to one schema, conflicts and unsupported fields refuse); `check_render` (every rendered field of every dimension checked or named unchecked; "none detected" only about checked fields).
- `adapters/profile_scratch.py`: per-run bundle directory with owner/lease/digest sidecar; atomic writes; owner-only read (digest verified; a tampered bundle is preserved and not used) and cleanup; `sweep` deletes only expired leases, never by age or prefix, and names what it kept.
- `application/profile_flow.py`: consent ledger → `prepare_model_input` (latest grant for user + policy hash; per-record statuses, counts and finding kinds; binding to revision and environment; **no record text in the ledger**) → `render` (bound verdict; renderable only with no findings and no unchecked field) → `finish` (owner only).
- `docs/contracts.md`: `INV-PROFILE-001`. Record: `docs/zeus/implementation/profile-privacy-001/` (README + `target-tests.json` with 5 negative controls).

## Verification

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| `tests/test_profile_privacy.py` + `test_architecture.py` (MemoryStore, real scratch directory, a child process that dies after writing its bundle) | 11 passed |
| Full Windows suite (Python 3.12, PG tests skipped; on main `1488468`) | 956 passed, 310 skipped, 1 failed: `test_github_tickets.py::test_remote_manual_close_is_a_conflict_not_local_acceptance[memory]` — pre-existing flaky test unrelated to this change (24 passed on three standalone runs) |
| `uv run ruff check .` | passed |
| Negative controls (notice wider than policy accepted / blocked kinds redacted instead of refused / only evidence checked at render / unchecked fields reported as none detected / anyone can clean up a run) | each makes the target tests fail |

## Not claimed

No real collection, model call, notice or questionnaire UI, or retention operation. The scan patterns were checked on synthetic inputs for the needed kinds; no recall or false-positive rate was measured, and free-text personal data (names, addresses) is outside the pattern set. Windows ACL errors were not exercised. Unit fixtures are not user acceptance, privacy qualification or deployment.

검토 반영 — `0235421` (P1: 허용 필드에서 제외한 본문이 모델 입력에 남음)

**변경**
- `domain/profile_privacy.py`: `parse_policy`가 `content, project_path, kind`가 빠진 fields를 **정책 단계에서 명시적으로 거절**합니다(이 셋 없이는 범위·동의 검사가 불가능). `minimize`의 입력은 정책 fields의 대응 필드(`content`, `project_ref`, `kind`, `session_ref`(해시), `observed_at`)만 담고, 정책이 이름하지 않은 필드는 어떤 형태로도 입력에 들어가지 않습니다.
- `application/profile_flow.py`: `retention.temporary=none`이면 scratch에 쓰지 않고 입력은 반환값(`input_records`)에만 존재하며 원장 행에는 남지 않습니다.

**테스트**: `fields={kind}` 정책 거절(메시지에 누락 필드), 확장 정책은 session_ref 해시 포함·원문 없음, temporary=none 실행은 번들 None·디렉터리 없음·원장에 텍스트 없음.

main(`66076cc`) 위로 rebase. 로컬: 7 passed; Ruff 통과.

reviews.body:
# PR #63: 변경 요청 / 병합 보류

검토 head: `6c5734010044125e07db98523f22723b121453eb`. Codex 독립 검토입니다.

**[P1] 허용 필드에서 제외한 본문이 모델 입력에 남습니다**

policy.fields={kind:...}로 설정해도 minimize는 content와 project_ref를 input에 항상 넣습니다. 실제 결과가 dropped_fields=[content,project_path]라고 하면서 그 content를 그대로 반환합니다. synthetic sentinel로 확인했으며 실제 사용자 대화나 비밀은 사용하지 않았습니다.

위치: [src/codex_harness/domain/profile_privacy.py:165](https://github.com/trevi00/zeus/blob/6c5734010044125e07db98523f22723b121453eb/src/codex_harness/domain/profile_privacy.py#L165)

수정·재검증 조건: 모델 입력을 승인한 fields로 실제 제한하고 필수 필드 조합이면 정책 단계에서 명시적으로 거절하세요. temporary=none 정책도 scratch write와 일치하도록 검사해야 합니다.

검증: 해당 head의 대상 검사 **11 passed in 0.72s**, Ruff 통과. 개별 대상 검사에 PostgreSQL 통합을 활성화했습니다. 통과 횟수는 파일 간 중복을 포함하므로 고유 테스트 수로 합산하지 않습니다.

실제 모델·사람 인수·실기기·재부팅 검증은 수행하지 않았습니다. PR 수용과 연결 이슈의 완료/종료는 별도입니다.

title: [FA-032] Bind the profile data flow to a policy whose notice it enforces and check every rendered field
